title: Concept: Development requirement declared as a wildcard
description: Pipfile declares a `*` specifier in `[dev-packages]`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` specifier in `[dev-packages]`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` specifier in `[dev-packages]`.
